settings-card.title: Local archive
settings-card.description: Save copies of relay messages to a local SQLite database in your Buzz nest. Events are re-verified against the relay at archive time.
settings-card.observer-description: Saves kind {{kind}} observer frames addressed to your pubkey. These are ephemeral — not stored by the relay — so local archiving is the only way to retain them.
settings-card.turn-metrics-description: Saves kind {{kind}} turn-metric events addressed to your pubkey. Stored as plaintext in your local archive so token-usage calculators can read them directly.
